note: Phase 3 native-adapter opt-in. This asset is packaged ONLY by an explicit LUCENT_INCLUDE_PHASE3_EDEN=1 build; a default/release APK has no phase3-qualification-opt-in.json asset at all, and NativeAdapterCatalog returns an empty catalog when it is absent, so every Phase 3 system keeps its external route. Listing an engine here is necessary but not sufficient: the pinned phase3 registry row must still declare route=native-adapter at this exact commit with shipped=false, the phase3 artifact manifest must record the adapter's SHA-256, and the adapter .so must be physically bundled and hash to that value.

userSuppliedRuntimeInputs.note: Console keys and the system firmware archive are user-supplied at runtime and are NEVER packaged. NativeAdapterSystemDirectory resolves them from external storage into the app-private engine-system/eden root and fails closed when they are missing.
